title: 第9章 重生者上第10章 重生者下
content_zh:
漆黑的乌云，遮蔽了天穹，将阳光阻挡在天空，使大地笼罩在黑暗之中。绵绵的细雨，从天空中散落，为残破的大地添增了一份凄凉与肃杀的气息。
一座结合古典与现代感的城池，座落在大地上。震天的枪炮声和嘶吼声，时不时从这座城中传来，让人知道这里并不平静。
原本高耸而宽厚的金属城墙，如今早已残破不堪。零星的火光在城墙上面闪烁着，伴随着枪声的是那一颗颗的子弹，不断的向城外飞射而去。硕果仅存的几门巨炮，屹立在城墙上，偶尔还是会发出它们的怒吼，为城外那残破的大地，添增一点伤疤。
各式各样变形变异的动植物，已经可以用怪物来称呼它们了。它们铺天盖地而来，不断的冲击着城墙，甚至有不少怪物直接顺着城墙上的裂痕攀爬而上。
许多人就手持着各种利器，在城墙上与怪物进行最原始的厮杀。各种尸体堆叠在城墙上，但是很快的又被人们推下了城墙。一方面是为了保持城墙上的阵线，另一方面又能顺势阻碍怪物的攀爬。
鲜红的血液在流淌着，将城墙染得通红，即便雨水不断的在洗刷着，但是很快就会有新的尸体和鲜血被制造出来，继续渲染着。
城池中央，一栋破损不大的房子，被几名护卫守卫着。轩辕亢明躺在里面的一个房间，他浑身是伤，被包扎的厚厚实实，他便是这个城池的主人。
前两天，轩辕亢明在城墙上协助防御怪物时，不慎被一只拥有C级实力的隐蜥偷袭，虽然轩辕亢明反手便了结了它的性命，但是仍免不了轩辕亢明被重伤的事实。
隐蜥，是变色龙经过进化后的形态，不仅能够隐形，连气息都能遮蔽的若有若无，在战场上那种复杂而喧闹的环境，极难察觉到它们的存在。它们的牙齿和爪子，有着剧烈的毒素，轩辕亢明仅管实力不俗，但是中了毒之后，即便及时解去了毒素，现在也只能躺在床上安养，防止伤势恶化。
听着从城墙那边传来的声音，他明白这座城已经守不住了。而重伤的他，如今也只能在床上等待着死亡的临近与到来。
躺在床上，他不禁回想起了“帝望”这款游戏。
想当初，便是因为他在游戏中的崛起，而造就了他。让他从微不足道的旁系血脉，一跃而起，成为家族新一代的领袖人物。曾几何时，他意气风发，挥斥方犹，手握数百万大军，坐拥三五座大城。
只是，在某些人的眼中，旁支永远都是旁支，加上当时的他，实在也是太过骄傲与狂妄。因此，家族的隐密从未有人告知于他，那怕他是真心实意的为家族牺牲奉献，最终仍难免遭遇各种阴谋暗算，强取豪夺。
若非他的能力不错，被认为还有一点利用的价值，而他还拥有着这么一座不为人知的小城，在“帝望”游戏关闭之时，他将一无所有。
还记得当游戏结束，“帝望”中的道具跟随着他回归现实世界时，他才真正明白，家族到底是怎样的一个存在。
“帝望”游戏从开启到关闭，一共只有短短五年的时间，可是对蓝星的影响却极为深远。无数新兴科技诞生，无数科技获得突破，整个蓝星的科技被一举推进了上百年的层度。而帝望游戏最后的馈赠，那些道具和装备，更使蓝星的底蕴被大大的提升。
然而，“帝望”游戏关闭后的现实世界，却已经不是人们所熟悉的那个世界了。
不仅仅是人类在进步，一切的动物，植物，昆虫，爬虫，鸟类，鱼类，都在疯狂的进化着，甚至还发生过许多袭击人类的事件。
起初，这些事件并未获得重视。凭着强大的科技力量，人类很轻易的便将有威胁的生物通通消灭，人们甚至还饶有兴致的进行捕捉和研究。
可是好景不长，短短三年的时间，人类便慢慢的从优势转为平衡对抗。这时人们才警觉起来，但是已经来不及了。这些生物们的进化速度越来越快，人类的努力，也只是暂缓衰败的速度而已。

到了第四年的时间，人类已经居于劣势。而现在，刚好期满第五年，人类的势力节节败退，而他也将葬身在这个地方......
想到这里，轩辕亢明惨然一笑。谁叫当初人类在“帝望”游戏中内斗的如此厉害，那些真正强力的装备和道具，不是在大战中被毁损，就是在大战中被消耗掉，要是能保存到“帝望”游戏关闭，将东西带回现实世界，人类又何苦沦落到现在的地步？
就在轩辕亢明万念俱灰之际，他透过窗户，看见了永生难忘的景色...
天空被撕裂了！
一道巨大的光柱从天而降，击散了天空中的乌云，带着无尽的威严降世，许多怪物在触碰到那道光柱之后，便化为了火炬。
这道光是什么？轩辕亢明下意识的便将目光往天空望去，他只看见了一个金色的图案，接着脑海中浮现了一道声音后，他的意识便陷入了黑暗之中。
龙国，首都，轩辕家
轩辕亢明突然从床上惊醒，他坐起身来，却感觉自身有种无比虚弱的感觉，但是他看了看四周，却惊讶的发现一种熟悉感。
“这...这不是我十年前的家吗？”轩辕亢明感觉脑袋有点发蒙。
过了好些时间，他才有了些许想法，直接打开一旁的电脑，看着上面显示的时间，还有网路上近期的新闻，他才接受了他“重生”了的事实。
照理来说，身为重生者，轩辕亢明应该要牛气冲天，恨不得将已往的仇敌一一消灭，然后在“帝望”扫六合，平八荒，成就自身的一番伟业。
但是说实话，轩辕亢明此时此刻，一点都没有着那样的想法。相反的，他有着一种“背负人类文明未来”的使命感，他在心中暗暗的下定了某种决心。
但是，前提是要先离开这里，然后找房子，同时还需要一个高级的游戏舱，以及大量的营养液。轩辕亢明心中盘算着。
对于轩辕亢明来说，轩辕家，已经不安全了。
content_en:
The dark clouds covered the sky, blocked the sunlight in the sky, and shrouded the earth in darkness. The continuous drizzle fell from the sky, adding a desolate and chilling atmosphere to the broken earth.
A city that combines classicism and modernity is located on the ground. The thundering sounds of gunfire and roars came from the city from time to time, letting people know that this place was not peaceful.
The originally tall and thick metal city walls were now in dilapidated condition. Scattered firelight flickered on the city wall, and along with the gunshots were the bullets that kept flying towards the outside of the city. The few remaining giant cannons stand on the city wall, and occasionally they still roar, adding a little scar to the broken land outside the city.
All kinds of deformed and mutated animals and plants can already be called monsters. They came in overwhelming numbers, constantly impacting the city wall, and many monsters even climbed directly along the cracks in the city wall.
Many people held various sharp weapons and fought with monsters on the city wall in the most primitive way. Various corpses were piled on the city wall, but they were quickly pushed down the city wall again. On the one hand, it is to maintain the front line on the city wall, and on the other hand, it can hinder the climbing of monsters.
The bright red blood is flowing, dyeing the city walls red. Even if the rain keeps washing, new corpses and blood will soon be created and continue to be painted.
In the center of the city, a small damaged house was guarded by several guards. Xuanyuan Kangming was lying in a room inside. He was covered in wounds and bandaged thickly. He was the master of this city.
Two days ago, when Xuanyuan Kangming was helping to defend against monsters on the city wall, he was accidentally attacked by a Hidden Lizard with C-level strength. Although Xuanyuan Kangming killed it with a backhand, the fact that Xuanyuan Kangming was seriously injured was inevitable.
Cryptolizards are the evolved form of chameleons. Not only can they be invisible, but their breath can also be obscured. Their presence is extremely difficult to detect in the complex and noisy environment on the battlefield. Their teeth and claws contained strong toxins. Although Xuanyuan Kangming was very strong, after being poisoned, even if the toxin was removed in time, he could only lie in bed to rest to prevent his injuries from getting worse.
Listening to the sounds coming from the other side of the city wall, he understood that the city could no longer be defended. Seriously injured, he can only wait in bed for the approach and arrival of death.
Lying on the bed, he couldn't help but think about the game "Diwang".
I think it was his rise in the game that created him. Let him rise from an insignificant sideline to become the leader of the new generation of the family. Once upon a time, he was high-spirited, scolding Fang You, holding millions of troops, and sitting on three to five big cities.
However, in the eyes of some people, side branches will always be side branches, and at that time, he was really too proud and arrogant. Therefore, no one has ever told him the secrets of the family. Even if he sincerely sacrifices himself for the family, he will inevitably encounter various conspiracies and plunders in the end.
If he hadn't had good abilities and was considered to be of some use, and he still owned such an unknown town, he would have nothing when the "Emperor's Hope" game was closed.
He still remembers that when the game ended and the props in "Emperor's Hope" followed him back to the real world, he truly understood what kind of existence the family was.
The "Emperor's Hope" game only took a short five years from its opening to its closing, but its impact on Blue Star was extremely profound. Countless emerging technologies were born, countless technological breakthroughs were made, and the entire Blue Star's technology was advanced to the level of hundreds of years in one fell swoop. And the final gifts of Diwang Game, those props and equipment, greatly improved Blue Star's foundation.
However, the real world after the "Emperor" game is closed, but it is no longer the world that people are familiar with.
Not only are humans progressing, but all animals, plants, insects, reptiles, birds, and fish are evolving crazily, and there have even been many attacks on humans.
Initially, these incidents received little attention. With the powerful power of science and technology, humans can easily eliminate all threatening creatures, and people even capture and study them with great interest.
But the good times did not last long. In just three years, mankind slowly shifted from advantage to balanced confrontation. Only then did people become alert, but it was already too late. The evolution speed of these creatures is getting faster and faster, and human efforts can only slow down the speed of decline.
By the fourth year, humans were already at a disadvantage. And now, just five years after the expiration of the term, human power is retreating steadily, and he will also be buried in this place...
Thinking of this, Xuanyuan Kangming smiled miserably. Who told humans to fight so fiercely among themselves in the "Emperor's Hope" game? Those truly powerful equipment and props were either destroyed or consumed in the war. If they could have been saved until the "Emperor's Hope" game was closed and things were brought back to the real world, why would humans have fallen to this point?
Just when Xuanyuan Kangming was despairing, he saw an unforgettable scenery through the window...
The sky is torn apart!
A huge beam of light fell from the sky, scattering the dark clouds in the sky, and came to the world with endless majesty. Many monsters turned into torches after touching the beam of light.
What is this light? Xuanyuan Kangming subconsciously looked towards the sky. He only saw a golden pattern, and then a voice appeared in his mind, and his consciousness fell into darkness.
Dragon Kingdom, capital, Xuanyuan family
Xuanyuan Kangming suddenly woke up from the bed. He sat up and felt extremely weak. However, when he looked around, he was surprised to find a familiar feeling.
"This...isn't this my home ten years ago?" Xuanyuan Kangming felt a little confused.
After a while, he had some ideas. He turned on the computer nearby and looked at the time displayed on it and the recent news on the Internet. Only then did he accept the fact that he was "reborn".
Logically speaking, as a reborn person, Xuanyuan Kangming should be so arrogant that he can't wait to destroy all his enemies in the past, and then conquer the world in "Emperor's Hope", pacify the wasteland, and achieve his own great cause.
But to be honest, Xuanyuan Kangming had no such thoughts at this moment. On the contrary, he had a sense of mission to "carry the future of human civilization", and he secretly made a certain determination in his heart.
However, the premise is to leave here first and then find a house. At the same time, you also need a high-end game cabin and a large amount of nutrient solution. Xuanyuan Kangming was thinking in his mind.
For Xuanyuan Kangming, the Xuanyuan family is no longer safe.
